notes.title: Sequel to Zipp's Café? Yes, and no! Chicken Police: Into the HIVE is out now!
notes.content:
[h2]WHAT THE CLUCK?![/h2]

As a fan of Zipp's Café, you probably heard about the World of Wilderness, the vast, and unique universe we created for our games. You may have heard about the Chicken Police too, the famous (or more like infamous) duo of detectives.

[b]Well, the time has come, the Chicken Police got its second full-length adventure INTO THE HIVE![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/77954bfbd860fcf6765cfdfff336d4cce19f4d1a.jpg[/img]

[h2]WHAT IS CHICKEN POLICE?[/h2]

Chicken Police: Into the HIVE! is a narrative-driven, "animal-noir-satire-adventure" where you play as Sonny Featherland and Marty MacChicken, the famous cop-duo called "The Chicken Police".

The game offers a city to explore, with jaw-dropping locations, amazing and weird characters, an original smoky, jazzy soundtrack, a complex and crazy conspiracy to uncover, and a 100% professional voiceover with a stellar cast!

The game is all about the characters and their relationships, interrogations, clue collecting, puzzle solving, and learning about the World of Wilderness. All this in a unique 2D-3D mashup style and a photomanipulation technique, and of course with a film-noir aesthetic.

[h2][b]FEATURES[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] more than 30 characters
[*] fully voiced by a stellar cast
[*] a thick noir atmosphere
[*] weird and buzzing locations
[*] a blood-pumping original soundtrack
[*] play in noir mode or in full (techni)color
[/list]

Check out our Launch Trailer:
[previewyoutube=WF0EFlSdVaw;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Chicken Police: Into the HIVE! is a deeply personal story set in a world, we created from scratch. It may resemble our world, but it has its own history, cultures, religions, political powers, and social constructs. [/i]

We hope you will enjoy the game we made with so much love and care! 
Please leave a review, and tell us what you think of it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362090/Chicken_Police_Into_the_HIVE/

Have an amazing day & week:
[i]The Wild Gentlemen[/i]

Join our Discord community and let's talk about the game or about games in general:
https://discord.gg/3na6emTAwr

notes.title: New life, new menu: Our biggest update is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, fellow baristas![/h2]

[h3]Our long-awaited biggest (and hopefully last) update has arrived, with lots of tweaks and bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs that lead to achievements not unlocking properly
[*] Fixed a lot of localization issues
[*] Fixed a bug with Art gallery pagination
[*] Fixed Steam SDK on Linux
[*] Fixed Steam Deck compatibility issues
[*] Fixed Notebook pagination issues
[*] Fixed a bug with the easy mode
[*] Fixed the pause menu where sometimes a softlock could occur
[*] Improved general controller support
[/list]

We've also fixed countless (nearly 100) smaller bugs, and included lots of minor updates to improve the overall gameplay experience.

Have a blast playing Zipp's Café![/h3]

...and don't forget to wishlist our other games from the Wilderness:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362090/Chicken_Police_Into_the_HIVE/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230450/Moses__Plato__Last_Train_to_Clawville/

[i]The Wild Gentlemen[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix #2 - Zipp's Café 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Dear players, dear friends, dear coffee lovers.[/h2]

The second hotfix batch has arrived!
You can read about the fixes below:

[list]
[*] Fixed a serious problem that was causing Linux and Steam Deck users to jam. (day 1 end progression bug)
[*] Fixed a couple of bugs that made some achievements unavailable. All achievements are now available to anyone.
[*] Fixed some Chinese and Russian localization issues.
[*] Cloud saving now works flawlessly.
[/list]

[i]The Wild Gentlemen team[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix #1 - Zipp's Café 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h2]Dear players, dear friends, dear coffee lovers.[/h2]

We are working hard to give you the best experience and to eliminate any bugs [i]- not you, Frank -[/i] you are so diligently reporting to us.

The first hotfix batch has arrived. You can read about the fixes below:

[list]
[*] There were some problems with the Chinese translation (recipe glitch) and some missing characters, which have been fixed.
[*] The "librarian raccoon" achievement was not always available, this has been fixed.
[*] In the food-making tutorial a text window tended to get stuck. It has been fixed.
[*] There was also a bug during the coffee-making tutorial, this has been fixed too.
[*] We also fixed an issue, where 'continue' was available right at the first install of the game, which could cause some troubles later.
[*] In addition to other minor bug fixes, the profile system has been also redesigned.
[/list]

There are still problems with some achievements, we are working on them, so you can expect another update very soon. In addition, we will be fixing several other issues in the following days, before the first really big update arrives.

notes.title: The first reviews are in!
notes.content:
[h3][b]The first reviews are in, folks, and we couldn't be happier![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704352/1d15e37f6282ad4c5e3ce1181e2a5e226378aac1.jpg[/img]

Our reviewers felt that although Zipp's Café is a small and short game, one thing is for sure, we put our hearts and souls into it and wanted to create a cute, bittersweet, cozy, and affordable game, that is not just a bridge between the two Chicken Police games, but much more: an entity in its own right.

[i]“jump into Zipp’s Café for the noir vibes and wonderful characters, but stay for the utterly enjoyable drink and food-making” [/i]
[b]GamesPew[/b]

[i]“the developer just loves their world and characters so very much."[/i]
[b]Destructoid[/b]

[i]"a breath of fresh air"[/i]
[b]But Why Tho?[/b]

[i]“The game has more energy than a double espresso and is as addictive as that third cup of coffee you probably shouldn’t have had”[/i]
[b]Geek Network[/b]

[i]"Even if you’re just here for the low-energy café atmosphere, Zipp’s Café seems a fine way to spend three quid on Steam and a couple hours of your time."[/i]
[b]Rock Paper Shotgun[/b]

[h3][b]So, what's next for Zipp's Café?[/b][/h3]

While we're absolutely bug-friendly - Frank can tell you that! - we're already working to fix all technical issues and remove all bugs that detract from the game experience on all platforms. So expect bug fixes, feature- and accessibility updates very, very soon!

In the meantime, keep playing and loving the game, report problems on the discussion forum, and of course leave a review if you feel the game was worth the price and gave you a good experience.

Play and chill a lot!
[i]The Wild Gentlemen team[/i]
